name: ModelVariant807_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant807_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a glow and a halo of triangles gather on a model part while orbiting sprites spiral out and the light dims, then a spinning ring on the opposing slot stretches upwards, fans out a rim and throws off sparks shedding fragments, and a flash leaves a fading core glow); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the orbit points and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 on each frame of the ring after the collapse time, 1 once when the flash starts, 2 once the flash has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-824 and 921 images build it from the same source with VERSION_FRENCH, whose full-screen flash covers 256 PAL lines. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
